The amendments were introduced by Labor Senator [Kim Carr](http://publicwhip-rails.openaustraliafoundation.org.au/mp.php?mpn=Kim_Carr&mpc=Senate&house=senate). Senator Carr explained that the purpose of the amendments is to "save the [Education Investment Fund](https://www.education.gov.au/education-investment-fund)" ('EIF'),(Read Senator Carr's full explanation of the amendment and the related debate [here](http://www.openaustralia.org/senate/?id=2014-07-17.70.1), after 1.35 pm. ) which the bill in its current form will abolish after its funds are redirected to the newly created Asset Recycling Fund.
